name: GitHub Plugin Configuration
description: Defines the single company-scoped, host-rendered configuration drawer for this demo plugin.

definition.title: Credentialed GitHub API Demo
definition.description: Save a non-secret company setting, configure the write-only GitHub credential, and manually fetch the approved safe output.

sections.title: Display settings
sections.description: Configuration values are company-specific. Do not enter secrets in this section.

fields.label: Connection label
fields.description: An optional non-secret label that helps identify this company's GitHub connection.

sections.title: GitHub connection
sections.description: SPRK stores the token in its credential vault and sends it only to the approved GitHub endpoint.
